terms.gloss: jerk, horror (as an insult); literally a ghost
evidence: Plaut. Merc. 5.4.20: etiam loquere, larua? (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: A term of abuse in Plautus, “hobgoblin, scarecrow” (Lewis & Short); see ghost.

sources: Lewis & Short: larva
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 335.
